scope: Hash-bound batch-5 summary over both exposed catalog binding types, every unique catalog-region row, and the complete property pointer/source-linkage denominator. Full numeric geometry and lossless property tuples are in the compressed evidence file.

propertyUniverse.propertyPointerInventory: propertyRows + propertyPaths + records + sourcePageContexts + fieldBindings + fieldBindingSets

mechanicsFieldDenominator.scope: Tracked mechanics-field leaves only; generated citation/provenance metadata is outside this denominator.

assessmentCounts.noSignalInterpretation: No structural candidate means only that the implemented text-layer geometry and language-shape rules emitted no signal. It is not a semantic pass.

historicalControls.scope: Historical evidence references and numeric crop calibration retained as regression controls; they are not new reviews and are not counted as current source-semantic confirmations.

controls.detectorRegressionCue: hyphenated crop endpoint or same-page column/page flow shape; this existing review is a historical control, not automatic confirmation
controls.disposition: preserve-regression-control; current catalog may now contain the known continuation

limits: Text-layer boxes can be imperfect and may represent OCR-like errors; edge crossings are candidates, not confirmed clipped ink.
No text layer, invalid/missing crop geometry, fold damage, decoration, tables, equations and nonprose layouts remain not-assessable or high-false-positive contexts.
The endpoint grammar detects shape cues, not sentence meaning, referents, source scope or correct continuation order.
This scan checks the supplied pages directly bound by exposed catalogs plus their immediate PDF neighbors; it is not a full-book semantic census.
Current declared continuation segments can satisfy a known historical case; this does not make unrelated no-signal regions complete.
validationContract: CI checks the compressed evidence hash, exact data and all catalog hashes/region/image/source bindings. Private PDFs are absent in CI, so source-page geometry cannot be regenerated there; PDF comparison is explicitly unavailable and must be regenerated locally when inputs change.
